name: sq_a
report: (() => { const rc = new THREE.Raycaster(); rc.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(0.081, -0.289), FLIGHT_PROBE.camera()); const hits = rc.intersectObjects(WORLD.scene.children, true).slice(0, 6); return JSON.stringify(hits.map(h => { let n = h.object, path = []; for (let o = n; o && path.length < 4; o = o.parent) path.push(o.name || o.type); const m = Array.isArray(n.material) ? n.material[0] : n.material; return { d: +h.distance.toFixed(1), path: path.join('<'), type: n.type, mat: m && (m.name || m.type), transp: !!(m && m.transparent), op: m && m.opacity, p: [h.point.x | 0, h.point.y | 0, h.point.z | 0] }; })); })()
